nodes.label: categories table
nodes.rationale: Modeled as a lookup table rather than a hardcoded enum so PRD-007A's fixed-category list can be entered as data once decided, with no schema migration.

nodes.label: price_history table (polymorphic, append-only)
nodes.rationale: One table with a source_type discriminator rather than two tables, matching ARCHITECTURE's data-design table; trade-off is a CHECK constraint instead of free NOT NULL enforcement.

nodes.label: quote_number_sequences table (internal counter, zero RLS policies)
nodes.norm_label: quote_number_sequences table (internal counter, zero rls policies)

nodes.label: quotes table (header + server-computed cost breakdown + lifecycle)
nodes.norm_label: quotes table (header + server-computed cost breakdown + lifecycle)

nodes.label: quote_lines table (one per fixed category + unlimited misc)
nodes.norm_label: quote_lines table (one per fixed category + unlimited misc)

nodes.label: fn_next_quote_number() RPC
nodes.rationale: SECURITY DEFINER hop so a policy-less quote_number_sequences table stays unreachable to any authenticated caller directly; race-freedom is structural via INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE ... RETURNING.

nodes.label: fn_save_quote() RPC
nodes.rationale: SECURITY INVOKER so RLS still applies row-by-row; deliberately not SECURITY DEFINER, which would silently discard owner-or-admin RLS on quotes/quote_lines.

nodes.label: fn_transition_quote_status() RPC
nodes.rationale: Thin wrapper only; the real enforcement is the validate_quote_status_transition trigger plus the owner-or-admin RLS policy.

nodes.label: validate_quote_status_transition() BEFORE UPDATE trigger
nodes.rationale: Four legal transitions, not three -- an earlier draft with only three would have raised on request-changes, silently deleting a documented path.

nodes.label: is_admin() SECURITY DEFINER helper function
nodes.rationale: SECURITY DEFINER so RLS policies on profiles itself do not recurse when they call it.

nodes.label: enforce_profile_role_change() trigger
nodes.rationale: Closes the profiles_update_self_or_admin self-escalation hole; carves out auth.uid() is not null so the first admin can still be promoted from the dashboard SQL editor.

nodes.label: 0004_settings_markup_units.sql
nodes.rationale: Reverses 0003's *_multiplier naming back to *_percent: a multiplier in numeric(5,2) steps one whole percentage point, reps type 18 not 1.18, and quote_lines.markup_percent already carries the percent unit.

nodes.label: Database-enforced approval gate
nodes.rationale: A BEFORE UPDATE trigger, not RLS, because WITH CHECK cannot see the old row and so cannot express a transition; structural guarantee rather than a UI convention.

nodes.label: Atomic multi-row save via Postgres RPC
nodes.rationale: Prevents partial saves from leaving quotes, tiers, defaults, or history inconsistent; no client-side sequential multi-step writes.
nodes.norm_label: atomic multi-row save via postgres rpc

nodes.label: Server-side pricing trust boundary
nodes.rationale: Client-side recalc is live-preview UX only; the server recomputes the canonical cost breakdown at save time so a tampered client cannot persist a fabricated margin.

nodes.label: Building UI: four-step process (shape -> tokens -> shadcn -> audit)
nodes.rationale: Only the last two steps are plugin decisions; impeccable audits but never writes UI, and /impeccable craft is banned because it builds as well as plans.
nodes.norm_label: building ui: four-step process (shape -> tokens -> shadcn -> audit)

nodes.label: Source-of-truth docs rule (read the relevant doc before proposing a change)
nodes.norm_label: source-of-truth docs rule (read the relevant doc before proposing a change)

nodes.label: Project state snapshot (Built / Not built, dated 2026-08-08)
nodes.rationale: Self-declared as a dated snapshot, not authoritative over the filesystem; a stale bullet is a finding against CLAUDE.md itself.
nodes.norm_label: project state snapshot (built / not built, dated 2026-08-08)

nodes.label: Use /db-migrate, never a bare db:push
nodes.rationale: Dev runs against a hosted project with no local stack and no db reset; the pre-flight in /db-migrate is the whole value a bare db push skips.

nodes.label: Applied migrations are unwritable (PreToolUse hook)
nodes.rationale: db push compares recorded versions, not file contents, so editing an applied file is skipped silently while reading as though it landed -- 0004 exists because that happened once.

nodes.label: /impeccable shape required first for UI-bearing work
nodes.norm_label: /impeccable shape required first for ui-bearing work

nodes.label: Three-tier token architecture (primitives / semantic / component variants)
nodes.rationale: Tier-1 primitives sit outside @theme so Tailwind emits no utility for them -- a primitive cannot be reached from a component even by accident.
nodes.norm_label: three-tier token architecture (primitives / semantic / component variants)

nodes.label: Semantic tokens only rule
nodes.rationale: Enforced by no-restricted-syntax in eslint.config.mjs rejecting raw palette classes and hex literals -- if it matters, the build enforces it.

nodes.label: WCAG AA accessibility floor (4.5:1 text, 3:1 non-text)
nodes.rationale: A floor, not an aspiration; five values were re-solved rather than shipped as the design export gave them because they failed once computed rather than eyeballed.
nodes.norm_label: wcag aa accessibility floor (4.5:1 text, 3:1 non-text)

nodes.label: Editable-vs-calculated field convention
nodes.rationale: The border carries the meaning, not the tint -- amber/warning tint alone reads at low contrast on a white card.

nodes.label: Dark mode is derived, not designed
nodes.rationale: Every dark value was solved and measured in this repo; none of it comes from the design source.
nodes.norm_label: dark mode is derived, not designed

nodes.label: Nav rail collapse breakpoint (xl, 220px/64px, 156px step)
nodes.rationale: At lg the step lands badly -- content area loses 155px going one pixel wider; at xl the same step still leaves 1060px of content clearing the quotes table.

nodes.label: Plan: adopting the local Docker stack
nodes.rationale: Triggered by onboarding developer #2, the first migration worth rehearsing destructively, or CI needing a database for E2E.
nodes.norm_label: plan: adopting the local docker stack

nodes.label: Free tier has no automated backups; dump before destructive migrations
nodes.rationale: Acceptable because the database holds seed and test data only; the exposure changes the moment real quotes exist.
nodes.norm_label: free tier has no automated backups; dump before destructive migrations

nodes.label: Four Placement Questions (route / shared component / write / else)
nodes.norm_label: four placement questions (route / shared component / write / else)

nodes.label: Prototype scaffolding on delete-when path (mock/, prototype/)
nodes.rationale: Quarantined in named folders so the delete is one rm -r each; the role switch must never be mistaken for authorization, which is RLS's job.
nodes.norm_label: prototype scaffolding on delete-when path (mock/, prototype/)

nodes.label: Deliberately Not Used tool list (Resend, Sentry, PostHog, pgmq, pg_cron, Edge Functions)
nodes.norm_label: deliberately not used tool list (resend, sentry, posthog, pgmq, pg_cron, edge functions)

nodes.label: Versions & Constraints (Node 24 LTS, no service-role key, Free plan)
nodes.norm_label: versions & constraints (node 24 lts, no service-role key, free plan)

nodes.label: Admin-owns-master-data authorization model
nodes.rationale: Chosen philosophy: reps do quoting; admins own the catalog, component library, global settings, branding, and the approval gate -- exactly two roles.

nodes.label: All writes RLS-enforced at the database, not just Server Actions
nodes.rationale: App-layer checks in Server Actions are UX only; the database is the trust boundary, so a bypassed or scripted client is denied by policy.
nodes.norm_label: all writes rls-enforced at the database, not just server actions

nodes.label: Option B: Supabase Storage with fixed object keys (recommended)
nodes.rationale: Runtime-safe for cloud deployments and consistent across instances, versus overwriting repo/static files at runtime which is not portable to typical production runtimes.
nodes.norm_label: option b: supabase storage with fixed object keys (recommended)

nodes.label: Multi-resolution ICO conversion rule (16/32/48/256px)
nodes.rationale: sharp cannot write ICO; it renders the four PNGs and the ICONDIR/ICONDIRENTRY container is assembled by hand.

nodes.label: settings.favicon_url has no writer under Option B (unresolved)
nodes.rationale: The column exists and is seeded NULL, but fixed object keys mean nothing populates it -- settle by writing the storage URL on upload or dropping the column.
nodes.norm_label: settings.favicon_url has no writer under option b (unresolved)

nodes.label: Open item: editing a quote after submission (freeze or not)
nodes.rationale: Neither PRD.md nor ARCHITECTURE.md says whether a rep may still edit line items once a quote leaves Draft; the model currently allows owner-or-admin content edits at any status.
nodes.norm_label: open item: editing a quote after submission (freeze or not)
